onboard_intro: A daily food-and-health record that helps you and your clinician see what is actually happening between visits. It is a tracking tool, not medical advice.
consent_body: You choose what to record. Your entries stay encrypted on this phone, and are sent to the Khai study server only if your coordinator gives you a server address. You can erase everything at any time. No name, address, Aadhaar number or contact list is collected. You may withdraw by erasing your data.
consent_check: I have read or heard this, and I agree to take part.
consent_meta: Consent version 1.0 · recorded on this device with a timestamp
disclaimer: Khai Tracker is a tracking tool, not medical advice. It never diagnoses and never changes a prescription.
search_food: Search a dish in English or Hindi
meds_hint: Tick what you actually did today.
meds_none: No medicines are listed in your profile. Add them once, then tick them off each day.
vitals_hint: Only fill what you measured. Blank means not measured, which is useful information too.
save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
already_saved: Saved. You can keep editing and save again.
history_hint: A filled square has an entry. Tap any day to review or correct it.
completeness_hint: Days with meals, medicines and a reading, divided by 21. Counted from saved entries, not from memory.
insights_empty: Keep logging for a week. Patterns appear once there are at least five days with readings.
insights_caveat: These are observations about your own entries, not a diagnosis and not a treatment recommendation.
export_hint: Share only with the people you choose. Files leave the phone only when you tap share.
privacy_body: Your entries are encrypted on this device with a key held in this phone\'s secure keystore. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you set a study server. There are no analytics and no advertising.
erase_confirm: This permanently deletes every entry, your profile and your reminder settings on this phone. This cannot be undone.
language_hint: Display only. Record values stay as stable codes, so switching never rewrites a day. Draft languages need native-speaker review before clinical use.
draft_notice: Draft translation — requires native-speaker review before clinical use.
reminder_hint: A quiet notification at the time you choose. No streak shaming, no ads.
pin_hint: Useful on a shared family phone. A 4-digit PIN is asked when the app opens, and again after a minute away.
pin_four: A PIN must be exactly 4 digits.
hide_previews: Hide this app in the recent-apps preview
sync_hint: Optional. Your coordinator gives you a server address. Leave empty to keep everything on this phone only.
sync_ok: Synced. All entries are on the server.
sync_fail: Sync failed. Entries are safe on this phone and will retry.
sync_offline: No internet right now. Entries queued.
sync_need_https: Use an HTTPS address. Health data is never sent unencrypted.
sync_bad_url: That does not look like a valid address.
about_body:
Khai Tracker 1.0.0
Built by Khai Foods Pvt Ltd, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India.

Designed for shared phones, patchy networks and mixed Indian plates. Offline first. No third-party analytics. No advertising.
read_aloud_unavailable: Speech for this language is not installed on this phone.
range_note: Estimates are ranges because the same dish varies by household. They are for pattern-finding, not counting calories.
notif_channel_desc: One daily reminder to record your day.
notif_text: Two quiet minutes: what did you eat, and what did you measure today?
notification_permission: Allow notifications so the daily reminder can reach you.
share_unavailable: No app on this phone can receive the file. Install a mail or file app and try again.
